The horizontal split executes the before→after temporal sequence as intended, the indigo thesis field commands the left half with BUILDABLE rendered as a drafting outline at marquee scale, and the pale evidence catalog proves the built work. The type treatment lands: Big Shoulders Display in outline reads as stamped architectural lettering, Atkinson Hyperlegible provides clean engineering-manual legibility, and the ruled lines enforce the spec-sheet material. The header folds into the hero properly—the pale title-block card anchors the mark and nav stack in the upper-left corner of the indigo field, all within the first fold. At 360, the split becomes a vertical sequence as declared; the idea survives: BUILDABLE still dominates the first fold at `5xl`, the phrase deck sits beneath it, and the evidence panel stacks directly below, preserving the before-above-after adjacency. The hierarchy is unambiguous at both widths. Measurables pass: 100% canvas utilization (floor 80%), 68.8% colour coverage (floor 45%), hero at 156px (inside the declared clamp). The palette is purposeful—262° indigo-violet reads as technical drafting ink, the vellum neutrals provide spec-sheet authenticity, and the accent lifts interactive states without noise. This is a confident execution of a genuine compositional risk (horizontal axis, split-to-sequence) that pays off because it serves the content: the phrase is literally temporal, and only a left-to-right reading path renders that sequence. Ship it.
